questions.question: God told Moses that Aaron's sons, the priests, must be holy and not profane His name. Why must they be holy?

answers.text: They present the LORD's food offerings
They were born first in their families

questions.question: God's rules said Israel's highest priest was allowed to defile himself for his dead father or mother. True or false?
Why was a descendant of Aaron with a physical defect not allowed to go near the veil or the altar?

answers.text: So he won't desecrate God's sanctuaries
So the altar fire keeps burning
So he can rest from his work

questions.question: A descendant of Aaron with a physical defect was still allowed to eat the holy food of his God. True or false?
